newsitem.title: CANADA: CWB official in Russia but no word on wheat deal.
newsitem.headline: CWB official in Russia but no word on wheat deal.

text.p: A Canadian Wheat Board sales officer was in Russia this week but there was no indication whether the grain exporter made any sales.
"Benoit Gauthier's in Moscow but I can't confirm if any business was discussed," CWB spokeswoman Deanna Allen said.
Gauthier, a sales officer with the CWB, is in the midst of a Oct 13 to 19 trip to Poland and Russia as part of a federal trade mission, along with representatives of about 30 Canadian firms.
Canada exported C$200 million in all types of goods to Russia in 1995.
Russia was US$100 million below its US$1.5 billion credit limit for grain purchases from Canada, Allen said.
Russia last bought Canadian wheat in 1992/93 (Aug/July) when it imported 1.317 million tonnes of milling wheat through the CWB, the CWB's annual report showed.
